purpose: Editorial research leads for a reviewed Vietnamese folk-poetry corpus. This register contains bibliographic leads only; it does not grant reuse rights or approve quotations.

sources.title: Kho tàng ca dao người Việt
sources.publisher: Nhà xuất bản Văn hóa Thông tin
sources.researchValue: The university-hosted introduction describes a compilation based on 37 earlier collections, with source references and variants. Google Books exposes bibliographic details and snippets, not enough to verify a particular entry or page.

sources.title: Tổng tập văn học dân gian người Việt, Tập 16: Ca dao tình yêu lứa đôi
sources.publisher: Nhà xuất bản Khoa học xã hội
sources.researchValue: The VOV library catalog describes sections for different relationship situations and offers the volume for library borrowing. The catalog is not the full text.

sources.title: Một số thể loại văn học dân gian Tĩnh Gia
sources.publisher: Tạp chí Văn hóa Nghệ thuật
sources.researchValue: The article discusses love and family themes and marks local collection origins for examples. Its notes cite a 2002 research article and an unpublished Hải Bình local gazette manuscript for some examples.
sources.rightsStatus: written permission required for reuse of the journal's published content

sources.title: Tục ngữ phong dao
sources.publisher: Việt Văn Thư Xã / Vĩnh Hưng Long Thư Quán
sources.sourceType: historical printed folk-literature collection; consulted through a later digital transcription
sources.researchValue: The transcription page says its text was transcribed from the 1928 collection and identifies the digitization project/contributors. The scanned-source link is listed but could not be opened in this research session. The compiler’s preface says the collection prioritizes gathering material, mixes forms, and may contain imperfect classifications; do not treat every item as an independently verified ca dao attribution.
sources.accessStatus: web transcription inspected; corresponding scanned page not collated
sources.rightsStatus: not reviewed; digital transcription has no explicit reuse grant on the inspected page
sources.provenanceStatus: the collection item inspected does not state a locality/community of origin

publicationChecklist: Store the exact selected variant and its book/page or article locator; compare the transcription against a scan or library copy.
Record the locality/community of origin when the source provides it; do not generalize a local variant as nationally representative.
Record a reviewer, a source URL, and an explicit reuse-rights decision before publication.
Keep AI reflection and action text separate from the unchanged folk quotation.

candidateIndex.editorialAssessment: The article presents this as a standalone two-line folk verse and explicitly attributes its collection to Hải Bình. It is a stronger provenance lead for a support mood than the 1928 nationwide compilation.
